hints.title: Asymmetric Edge Weights
hints.text: Traversing toward an even-indexed node costs two seconds while traversing toward an odd-indexed node costs one second.

hints.title: Subtree Rerooting Top-Two Paths
hints.text: In the first pass, compute the two longest paths down from each node into its subtrees, recording the best and second best child branches.

hints.title: Parent Contribution Re-propagation
hints.text: In the second pass, push down the maximum distance arriving from the parent side, selectively taking the second best branch if descending into the heaviest branch.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in the tree
complexity.notes: Two depth-first passes over n tree nodes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running traversal from each node independently takes quadratic O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory stores tree adjacency and top-two subtree branches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies tree rerooting technique with top-two subtree paths in linear time.
